answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the tide bond on all of them and exposing each to the shale slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 16 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the prism audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 476 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
